follow-up time: The infants were monitored for at least 3 hours on the first day of life
outcome: Amplitude of the lower margin on aEEG
cohort: 60 preterm infants with gestational age between 23 and 32 weeks, without malformations
finding: Biological variables and clinical severity were associated with aEEG characteristics of preterm infants on the first day of life.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was associated with a burst-suppression pattern on aEEG.
